chain.title: Under the Canopy
chain.desc: Fill a two-by-two pool with water, ring it with flowers, and throw in a diamond. The lightning drops you into a forest held at permanent dusk.

chain.title: Black Feather, Small Bird
chain.desc: Ravens perch in the canopy and inside twilight forest houses. Their feathers are the first ingredient of every magic map you will ever draw.

chain.title: A Lens for the Wood
chain.desc: Raven feather, torchberries and glowstone dust. Wrapped in paper it becomes a map that reveals structures rather than terrain.

chain.title: The Coiled Serpent
chain.desc: The Naga circles its scale-walled courtyard in straight charges. Break each charge and it sheds armour in phases until it dies.

chain.title: Scales Turned Outward
chain.desc: Naga scales stitched into a tunic. It carries more durability than any comparable early armour and marks the first boss as beaten.

chain.title: The Tower Falls Quiet
chain.desc: The Lich hides behind orbiting shield orbs; reflect his bolts back with a sword to strip them, then chase him through his summoned minions.

chain.title: Bolts of Dusk
chain.desc: Dropped by the Lich. It fires homing bursts of twilight magic and recharges from ender pearls in the crafting grid.

chain.title: Head on the Wall
chain.desc: The Lich's trophy. Mounted on a trophy pedestal it becomes the key to the next tier of the forest, not merely a decoration.

chain.title: Roots That Still Breathe
chain.desc: Chop the pale root blocks knotted into hollow hills and twilight oaks. Liveroot is the organic half of ironwood.

chain.title: Wood Made Metal
chain.desc: Liveroot, raw iron and a gold nugget bound into raw ironwood, then smelted. The finished gear slowly repairs itself while carried.

chain.title: Reading the Labyrinth
chain.desc: Found in labyrinth and maze chests. It draws a map that cuts through stone to show corridors, and it is also the core of the uncrafting table.

chain.title: Bull in the Maze
chain.desc: The Minoshroom guards the heart of the Labyrinth beneath the swamp, charging down its long halls. It drops the raw meef nobody else carries.

chain.title: Bowl of the Bullslayer
chain.desc: Cooked meef, a bowl and mushrooms. Eating it is the game's own recorded proof that the Labyrinth has been cleared.

chain.title: Green Metal
chain.desc: Dropped by the Labyrinth's kobolds and hoarded in its vaults. Steeleaf tools swing faster than diamond and armour up the whole set.

chain.title: Three Heads, Then More
chain.desc: The Hydra squats in its lair breathing fire and lobbing mortars. Sever the heads faster than the stumps regrow or the fight never ends.

chain.title: Blood Poured into Iron
chain.desc: The Hydra's fiery blood and tears, forged together with an iron ingot. Fiery gear sets alight whatever it touches.

chain.title: Claiming the Kill
chain.desc: Set a boss trophy on this pedestal and stand on it yourself; the game then formally advances your forest progression to the next gate.

chain.title: Armour Without a Body
chain.desc: The Knight Phantom rides through the Goblin Knight Stronghold in an empty suit, spawning phantom lances as its health falls.

chain.title: Shards Reforged
chain.desc: Armour shards from the stronghold's goblins, clustered nine at a time and smelted. It makes the block-and-chain and a shield that never dulls.

chain.title: Redstone Given Malice
chain.desc: Borer essence from towerwood borers, ghast tears and redstone. It powers the reactors and vanishing blocks that open the Dark Tower's sealed rooms.

chain.title: The Weeping Tower
chain.desc: The Ur-Ghast hovers above the Dark Tower's roof, raining fire and summoning ghastlings. Its tears are the payment for the climb.

chain.title: White Fury in the Caves
chain.desc: The Alpha Yeti hurls you around its ice cave. Its fur is the only material that lets you survive the glacier waiting above.

chain.title: The Aurora Throne
chain.desc: The Snow Queen drops from the ceiling of the Aurora Palace between ice-shard barrages. She is the last boss the glacier holds.

chain.title: Something Left Cooking
chain.desc: A block of pale cake abandoned in the Goblin Knight Stronghold's laboratory. Eat it in slices, and placed back down it regrows itself.

notes: Verified against twilightforest-1.20.1-4.3.2508-universal.jar. Every item id resolves to assets/twilightforest/models/item/<id>.json; every kill: target is a real entity key in assets/twilightforest/lang/en_us.json (naga, lich, minoshroom, hydra, knight_phantom, ur_ghast, alpha_yeti, snow_queen); the dimension id is confirmed by data/twilightforest/dimension/twilight_forest.json. The spine order is not guessed - it is lifted from the mod's own advancement graph in data/twilightforest/advancements/: root (portal) -> progress_naga -> progress_lich, which then branches to progress_trophy_pedestal, progress_labyrinth and progress_yeti; progress_labyrinth -> progress_hydra; progress_trophy_pedestal -> progress_knights -> ghast_trap -> progress_ur_ghast; progress_yeti -> progress_glacier; then progress_merge -> troll -> progression_end, with experiment_115 hanging off progress_knights. Two non-obvious details are confirmed there: progress_labyrinth's real criterion is EATING twilightforest:meef_stroganoff (so it is Minoshroom-gated), and progress_knights is gated on progress_trophy_pedestal - which is why trophy_pedestal appears in the chain as a real step rather than decor. Intermediate crafts verified from data/twilightforest/recipes/: magic_map_focus = raven_feather + torchberries + glowstone dust; magic_map = paper + magic_map_focus; raw_ironwood = liveroot + raw_iron + gold nugget, then smelted or blasted to ironwood_ingot; knightmetal_ingot smelted from armor_shard_cluster; fiery_ingot = a fiery vial (fiery_blood / fiery_tears) + an iron ingot; carminite = borer_essence + redstone + ghast_tear. Carminite is placed BEFORE the Ur-Ghast on purpose: it is the Dark Tower's internal progression material (carminite_reactor, carminite_builder, vanishing_block), not a boss drop. PACK CONSENSUS: every high-count moddb twilightforest entry appears here in the chain or a wheel - lich_trophy (7 packs), naga_trophy (6), twilight_scepter (5), naga_chestplate (5), magic_map_focus (4), magic_map (4), steeleaf_helmet (4), raven_feather (3), naga_scale (3), transformation_powder (3), charm_of_life_1/2, ore_magnet, uncrafting_table, quest_ram_trophy. NO consensus item contradicted the advancement graph - the packs and the mod agree on this spine. Chain slots were tight at 24, so these consensus items were routed into collection wheels instead of the spine: naga_scale, every non-Lich trophy, the other three scepters, transformation_powder, ore_magnet, charm_of_life_1, charm_of_keeping_1. Consensus items deliberately left out entirely (verified present in the jar, safe as optional quests): glass_sword, ender_bow, ice_bow, ice_sword, uncrafting_table, naga_banner_pattern, lich_banner_pattern, minoshroom_banner_pattern, raw_venison, lich_tower_miniature_structure, ironwood_helmet, fiery_chestplate, steeleaf_helmet. ID CAUTION: twilightforest:magic_map is the BLANK map and twilightforest:filled_magic_map is the drawn one (same for maze_map / filled_maze_map and ore_map / filled_ore_map). moddb's consensus id is the blank craftable, which is what a craft-this task should target; the advancements instead check the filled_* variants. DROPPED: none - every id in this file verified.
